verdict.rationale: Rollbar exposes a RESTful API covering much of the system's data, including reporting deploys and listing items, with scoped access tokens. That allows headless automation, and deploy notifications fit naturally into a release pipeline. However, nothing in the evidence documents an official CLI, CI-pipeline integration or GitHub Action, or a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404 on every candidate path), so CI use would rely on raw API calls. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI plugin, documented CI workflow (e.g. deploy or source-map upload steps in a pipeline), machine-readable OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration.
